plan.what: The Dark Told Me: scary stories, one channel per language. English @TheDarkToldMe, Arabic @TheDarkToldMeAR.
plan.launch: The owner, Nov 21 2026 (22:52 Pacific): post the 19 ready videos of each language within the next 24 hours, then move to the new format.
plan.youtube_route: Buffer first (its free plan sends 2 YouTube posts per channel in any 24 hours; the -yt queue files keep 24 h 20 min between a channel's posts). YouTube Studio in the owner's Chrome for the rest, once he has verified the two new channels (Studio answers 'Daily upload limit reached' until then).
plan.rule: Always try every method (the owner, Nov 2026): when one method fails, the next one in accounts.<lang>.routes posts it; report only when all have failed.
plan.tiktok: TikTok takes 15 posts through the API per account in any 24 hours (kit/series/NIGHT_NOTES.md, Nov 11 2026), so stories 16-19 of the launch go to TikTok once stories 1-4 are 24 hours old: the queue files ending in -tt. A TikTok post refused as 'potential spam' is refused on the request, not on the video: queue it again a few hours later.
plan.timing: GitHub's own timer runs hours late or not at all in this repo, so posts are handed to Buffer up to lead_minutes ahead (9 hours: at most 8 waiting per channel, Buffer's free plan holds 10) and the workflow 'Scary clock' starts 'Scary posts' every clock.every_minutes until clock.until.
